import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 25;
    static final int MAXV = 2 * MAXN * MAXN + 10; // increased to accommodate n=25
    static final int MAXE = 400005;
    static final int INF = 1000000007;
    static final int SRC = 501, SNK = 502;

    static char[][] A = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] B = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] Zdist = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][][][] pairDist = new int[MAXN][MAXN][MAXN][MAXN];

    static int[] head = new int[MAXV];
    static int[] toEdge = new int[MAXE];
    static int[] nxtEdge = new int[MAXE];
    static int[] capEdge = new int[MAXE];
    static int[] flowEdge = new int[MAXE];
    static int edgeCnt;
    static int[] parentEdge = new int[MAXV];
    static int[] used = new int[MAXV];
    static int[] dep = new int[MAXV];
    static int answer;
    static int[] dx = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 0, -1, 1};

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        toEdge[edgeCnt] = v;
        capEdge[edgeCnt] = cap;
        flowEdge[edgeCnt] = 0;
        nxtEdge[edgeCnt] = head[u];
        head[u] = edgeCnt++;
        toEdge[edgeCnt] = u;
        capEdge[edgeCnt] = 0;
        flowEdge[edgeCnt] = 0;
        nxtEdge[edgeCnt] = head[v];
        head[v] = edgeCnt++;
    }

    static boolean bfsLevel() {
        Queue<Integer> qu = new LinkedList<>();
        Arrays.fill(used, 0);
        Arrays.fill(dep, 0);
        qu.add(SRC);
        used[SRC] = 1;
        dep[SRC] = 1;
        while (!qu.isEmpty()) {
            int x = qu.poll();
            for (int i = head[x]; i != -1; i = nxtEdge[i]) {
                int y = toEdge[i];
                if (used[y] == 0 && flowEdge[i] < capEdge[i]) {
                    parentEdge[y] = i;
                    used[y] = 1;
                    dep[y] = dep[x] + 1;
                    qu.add(y);
                    if (y == SNK) return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int sendFlow(int x, int now) {
        if (x == SNK || now == 0) return now;
        int rem = now;
        for (int i = head[x]; i != -1; i = nxtEdge[i]) {
            int y = toEdge[i];
            if (capEdge[i] > flowEdge[i] && dep[y] == dep[x] + 1) {
                int pushed = sendFlow(y, Math.min(rem, capEdge[i] - flowEdge[i]));
                if (pushed == 0) dep[y] = 0;
                flowEdge[i] += pushed;
                flowEdge[i ^ 1] -= pushed;
                rem -= pushed;
                if (rem == 0) break;
            }
        }
        return now - rem;
    }

    static void dinic() {
        while (bfsLevel()) {
            answer += sendFlow(SRC, INF);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int timeLimit = sc.nextInt();
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        edgeCnt = 0;

        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                Zdist[i][j] = 10000;
                A[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
                if (A[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    q.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    Zdist[i][j] = 0;
                }
                if (A[i][j] <= '9') {
                    addEdge(SRC, (i - 1) * n + j, A[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                if (nx > 0 && ny > 0 && nx <= n && ny <= n && A[nx][ny] <= '9' &&
                    Zdist[nx][ny] > Zdist[x][y] + 1) {
                    Zdist[nx][ny] = Zdist[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (A[i][j] > '9') continue;
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++)
                    for (int l = 1; l <= n; l++)
                        pairDist[i][j][k][l] = 10000;
                q.add(new int[]{i, j});
                pairDist[i][j][i][j] = 0;
                while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                    int[] cur = q.poll();
                    int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
                    for (int f = 0; f < 4; f++) {
                        int nx = x + dx[f], ny = y + dy[f];
                        if (nx > 0 && ny > 0 && nx <= n && ny <= n && A[nx][ny] <= '9' &&
                            pairDist[i][j][nx][ny] > pairDist[i][j][x][y] + 1 &&
                            pairDist[i][j][x][y] < Zdist[x][y]) {
                            pairDist[i][j][nx][ny] = pairDist[i][j][x][y] + 1;
                            q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                        }
                    }
                }
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++)
                    for (int l = 1; l <= n; l++)
                        if (pairDist[i][j][k][l] <= Math.min(Zdist[k][l], timeLimit))
                            addEdge((i - 1) * n + j, (k - 1) * n + l + 100, 10000);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                B[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
                if (B[i][j] <= '9')
                    addEdge((i - 1) * n + j + 100, SNK, B[i][j] - '0');
            }
        }

        dinic();
        System.out.println(answer);
        sc.close();
    }
}
